### Client retention versus client acquisition strategy

Infosys generated 10 billion dollars from 1,000 clients while Cognizant required 5,000 clients for identical revenue.
Infosys maintained a 97% client retention rate over 50 years of operation.
Prioritizing existing client service drives higher financial growth than continuously hunting new acquisitions.
High client retention commands superior stock market valuations compared to high-churn competitor models.

### Role-specific outcome mindsets

Marwa focused strictly on delivering measurable outcomes for existing clients rather than new acquisitions.
Constant client hunting without retention creates a leaky bucket model limiting business success.
